definitions.explanation: A person one knows but is not necessarily close friends with. Less intimate than a friend but more than a stranger.

examples.english: I ran into an acquaintance in town.

examples.japanese: {知人|ちじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a job through an acquaintance's introduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦というより→というより：17867_toiuyori⟧{知人|ちじん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He's more of an acquaintance than a friend.

notes:
RELATIONSHIP SPECTRUM:
- ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (stranger)
- {知人|ちじん} (acquaintance)
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧ (acquaintance - less formal)
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧/⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ (friend)
- ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧ (close friend)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {知人|ちじん} - slightly formal; often used in written language
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧ - casual; more common in spoken language

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {知人|ちじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to be introduced by an acquaintance)
- {知人|ちじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧ (through an acquaintance)
